newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss December inflation rises to 0.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss December inflation rises to 0.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices rose 0.1 percent in December from November for a year-on-year inflation rate of 0.8 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said. In November the year/year rate was 0.7 percent.
Monthly CPI index change +0.1 pct -0.2 pct 0.0 pct
The average inflation rate for all of 1996 was 0.8 percent. This compared with a yearly average rate in 1995 of 1.8 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
December price increases were attributed mainly to gains the subindex foodstuffs, beverages and tobacco products. The gains were caused mainly by seasonal factors, it said.

Rent and energy prices were also slightly higher, as well as prices of home furnishings. The cost of entertainment, relaxation, education and culture declined, as did the cost of transportation and communication.
